population.admission: tracked -09-67a market-day roster; features_long rows with both high_so_far and current_temp present
population.ordering: captured_at_utc ascending, with original CSV row order as the stable tie-break
population.event_definition: current high_so_far is strictly below the immediately preceding admitted row in the same market-day

classification.M1_restatement: both WU row sets are non-empty, row counts and latest datetime are unchanged, and at least one row temperature changed at the same series position
classification.M2_empty_history: current WU rows are empty or current wu_history.max is missing, and served high_so_far equals served current_temp
classification.M3_rows_dropped: the current WU series contains fewer rows than the preceding captured series
classification.M4_source_switch: the inferred source kind for served high_so_far changed between adjacent captures
classification.M5_cutoff_change: the recorded cutoff_hour changed between adjacent captures
classification.M6_unexplained: none of M1-M5 is evidenced by the emitted discriminants

direction_reconciliation.cutoff_delta: signed cutoff_hour - previous_cutoff_hour; negative narrows and positive widens
direction_reconciliation.capture_minute: derived from the captured_at_local field written beside the feature vector; it is not the producer of cutoff_hour
direction_reconciliation.rows_lost_within_window: timestamped WU rows admitted by the previous cutoff that are absent from the current cutoff-filtered series; this includes raw-series disappearance and boundary exclusion

candidate_definitions.max_rows_served_path: recorded served high_so_far; this is the max(rows) path when WU rows exist and its captured fallback otherwise
candidate_definitions.wu_history_max_c: captured wu_history.data.max_native, falling back to legacy max_c; values remain in the market native settlement unit
candidate_definitions.wu_current_max_since_7am_c: captured wu_current.data.max_since_7am_native, falling back to legacy max_since_7am_c; values remain in the market native settlement unit

train_serve.training_value: maximum archived native-unit row temperature with minute_of_day <= cutoff_hour*60, matching build_historical_feature_record
